comment: No source is published; the maker's page is at kilpatrickaudio.com/?p=virtue-vcv. The module declares 12 parameters: four buttons, the encoder, the two speed buttons, and five more with no name, no widget and no census position, which are the per-button latch flags and the backlight. None of those five can be clicked, so none gets a line. Index order is not panel order: the encoder is param 4 and sits above the four buttons, and the two speed buttons are params 5 and 6 between them.
